RESULT v1 | k907834ed50 | Each logical write is rewritten several times as data moves through memtable flushes and compaction levels, so physical writes exceed logical writes by the amplification factor; the consequence is that sustained write throughput is divided by that factor and SSD endurance is consumed proportionally faster.
